column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules (Sprint 18.1b). Format: rule id <TAB> IGNORE|WARN|FAIL <TAB> (name). Rules not listed are WARN.
# FAIL: headers and cookie flags WURK always sends. IGNORE: what can't apply to a plain-HTTP CI server or is expected.

column3: (X-Content-Type-Options — CI's artisan serve sends static files without Laravel; pages are tested in SecurityHeadersTest, static files get it from docker/production/Caddyfile)
(Cookie No HttpOnly Flag — XSRF-TOKEN is read by the page by design; the session cookie's HttpOnly is tested in SecurityHeadersTest)
(Cookie Without Secure Flag — CI runs on plain HTTP; production is HTTPS-only)
(Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set — HTTP in CI; tested in SecurityHeadersTest)
(X-Powered-By — the CI PHP shows it; the production image sets expose_php = Off)
(Timestamp Disclosure — build hashes and dates in bundles)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments — in minified bundles)
(Storable and Cacheable Content — static assets are meant to be cached)
(Sub Resource Integrity Attribute Missing — scripts are same-origin)
